discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Recent prizes went to quantum circuits in 2025, machine learning in 2024 and attosecond physics in 2023, so condensed matter looks due for a turn. Topological insulators are a field-defining, heavily cited discovery that has long been tipped for the prize, and they have a clean theory-plus-experiment trio: Kane and Mele predicted the quantum spin Hall effect, and Molenkamp's group observed it in HgTe quantum wells.
